bundle.shortDescription: Read-only COM port inspector and loopback tester
bundle.longDescription: PortDock Port Inspector shows, for one COM port, the device and driver (provider, version, date, INF), the Device Manager problem code with what it means, the USB chip from VID/PID, device settings such as the FTDI latency timer, Windows port defaults, USB power saving, recent plug and driver events, and COM number reservations — read-only, without administrator rights. With TX and RX tied together it measures round-trip bytes and milliseconds per baud rate, and it tells whether a 2-wire RS-485 adapter echoes what it sends.
